# Data from Table 2 - Computed Interest Charge - Public debt column
# FY 1961-1967 for fitting, FY 1968 for actual

# Years and values (in millions of dollars)
# t = 0 in FY 1961
data = {
    1961: {'t': 0, 'interest': 3072},
    1962: {'t': 1, 'interest': 3240},
    1963: {'t': 2, 'interest': 3361},
    1964: {'t': 3, 'interest': 3561},
    1965: {'t': 4, 'interest': 3678},
    1966: {'t': 5, 'interest': 3988},
    1967: {'t': 6, 'interest': 4039},
    1968: {'t': 7, 'interest': 4499}  # Actual value
}

# Print the data
print("Data for OLS regression (FY 1961-1967):")
for year in range(1961, 1968):
    print(f"  FY {year}: t={data[year]['t']}, interest={data[year]['interest']}")
print(f"\nActual FY 1968: {data[1968]['interest']}")

# Perform OLS regression
import numpy as np

t_vals = np.array([data[y]['t'] for y in range(1961, 1968)])
y_vals = np.array([data[y]['interest'] for y in range(1961, 1968)])

print(f"\nt values: {t_vals}")
print(f"y values: {y_vals}")

# OLS: y = a + bt
# Using formula: b = cov(t,y)/var(t), a = mean(y) - b*mean(t)
t_mean = np.mean(t_vals)
y_mean = np.mean(y_vals)

print(f"\nMean t: {t_mean}")
print(f"Mean y: {y_mean}")

# Calculate b (slope)
b = np.sum((t_vals - t_mean) * (y_vals - y_mean)) / np.sum((t_vals - t_mean)**2)
# Calculate a (intercept)
a = y_mean - b * t_mean

print(f"\nOLS Results:")
print(f"  b (slope) = {b:.6f}")
print(f"  a (intercept) = {a:.6f}")

# Predict for FY 1968 (t=7)
t_1968 = 7
y_forecast_1968 = a + b * t_1968
print(f"\nForecast for FY 1968 (t={t_1968}): {y_forecast_1968:.2f} million")

# Calculate forecast error
actual_1968 = data[1968]['interest']
forecast_error = y_forecast_1968 - actual_1968

print(f"Actual FY 1968: {actual_1968} million")
print(f"Forecast error = {y_forecast_1968:.2f} - {actual_1968} = {forecast_error:.2f} million")

# Round to nearest hundredths
print(f"\nRounded forecast error: {round(forecast_error, 2)} million")
EOF
